title.zh: 发布本地化站点免责声明

purpose.en: Give every interface language supported by this site a clear disclaimer covering AI-assisted content, possible accuracy and pricing errors, third-party platforms, crypto risk, and final non-refundable payments.
purpose.zh: 为本站支持的每种界面语言提供清晰免责声明，涵盖 AI 辅助内容、准确性与定价错误、第三方平台、加密资产风险以及最终且不可退款的付款。

en: Add a localized Disclaimer link between Terms and Project in the public footer.
Publish a dedicated disclaimer page using reviewed static copy for every supported interface language.
zh: 在公共页脚的条款与项目链接之间新增本地化免责声明链接。
以经过审阅的静态文案，为每种受支持的界面语言发布独立免责声明页面。

en: Public footer, disclaimer route, and Project release history
zh: 公共页脚、免责声明路由与 Project 发布历史

en: Cover AI-generated inaccuracies and pricing errors, X, Facebook, TikTok, wallet apps, and crypto exchanges.
State that all payments are final and non-refundable except where applicable law requires otherwise.
zh: 覆盖 AI 生成内容不准确与定价错误，以及 X、Facebook、TikTok、钱包应用和加密资产交易平台。
明确除适用法律另有强制要求外，所有付款均为最终付款且不可退款。

en: Run the disclaimer contract test and production build.
Deploy through GitHub Actions and Cloudflare, verify the production footer and disclaimer content, and confirm the exact Project record.
zh: 执行免责声明契约测试与生产构建。
通过 GitHub Actions 与 Cloudflare 发布，验证生产页脚与免责声明内容，并确认 Project 精确记录。

en: SmartLingo and GeniusWallet remain outside this migration while their active development tasks are unfinished.
zh: SmartLingo 与 GeniusWallet 的开发任务尚未完成，因此暂不纳入本轮迁移。

en: Preserve GreatLoveMeta branding, ecosystem destinations, independent data, and cloud resources while adopting true locale routing.
zh: 采用真实语言路由时，保留 GreatLoveMeta 的品牌、生态目的地、独立数据与云资源。
